description: Autonomous trader for Hands. Returns the live target book. Read `calls` / `say` for conviction. Size and exits are yours — Talon recommends, it does not fill. POST holdings for a diff. GET is the book only. Poll every 5–15 min. Talon does not sign. Honor avoid. Not financial advice.

holdings.description: What you currently hold under this policy. Each item needs address; sizeUsd, mcapEntry, openedAt optional. When present, orders is the exact delta to match target.
